_evidence: 0x0041891a scans the 16 entries at 0x0063decc (stride 0x2c) for the first whose dwords +0 and +4 are both zero (or + je: returns its address with clc), else stc after 16. Only those two dwords per entry are read (state; fuzz varied only the first). Each draws 0 in 2/7 of the cases (independently, so one-zero entries occur), giving a free entry with probability ~1/12: first hits at every depth and about a quarter exhausted scans. Any value is valid.
